- steady-state cost per 1M queries under $X (discussed in pricing call)
- nightly batch re-ingest of ~500k documents completes within 4 hours without impacting peak serving

Sales/ops shorthand: demo 2026-02-24 ok, SE to push performance numbers + test harness. Finance looking at committed monthly pricing for Dedicated (prefer annual commit if ROI proven).

use_case_summary: Customer is a SaaS product team using document and product catalogs to power search and recommendations. They need embeddings for semantic search + reranking; queries are mixed (user-facing low-latency search + batch similarity scoring for recommendations). They expect to validate via hosted API, then commit to Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower unit costs.
technical_requirements: Throughput targets: 150-200 QPS for embedding lookups; tail P95 lookup latency target <= 50ms. Batch jobs: nightly embedding of ~500k docs (0.7-1B tokens) with incremental rebuilds; occasional full reindex of ~10M items monthly. Vector DB integration: Pinecone preferred for POC; must support inner-product similarity, sharded indexes and efficient bulk upserts. Model preferences: open/quantized embeddings ok if quality matches, interested in Redwood's model catalog recommendations and quantization guidance. Routing/fallback: want auto-fallback to smaller model for spikes, and ability to route high-cost jobs to lower-cost capacity tier.
pricing_notes: Wants hosted for POC (free credits), then Dedicated if 3-week POC metrics meet SLA. Interested in committed monthly capacity to reduce unit costs. Key ask: example TCO for 100M queries/month and incremental pricing for nightly batch reindex windows.
demo_feedback: Liked streaming and SDK ease-of-use. SE ran 10k synthetic queries: median latency 28ms on hosted, P95 72ms for single shard; Marcus recommends model/kernel tuning. Aaron: 'Nice API ergonomics; we need tighter P95 for production.'
